title: Nori hình thái 3 · tuyệt kỹ mới (sheet skill)
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body, weapon and shield always inside the frame with a margin, the face visible, the flat solid magenta background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth, cape and loose pieces always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

segments.name: A
segments.prompt: A chibi young forest knight with messy brown hair, big golden antlers with leaves and green eyes, in ornate white-gold and emerald armour wrapped in pale roots and covered in green leaves, a huge emerald crystal war hammer bound with pale roots in his right hand and a large emerald shield with a golden tree emblem framed by roots and leaves in his left, from his guard stance thrusts his big emerald shield forward and plants its lower rim firmly on the ground in front of him, bracing behind it, into the pose of the last frame. Feet adjust minimally between the supplied endpoint stances, staying grounded without sliding or hopping; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve his identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid hammer and the single shield, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.
